build_BannedKeywords: build a banned keywords filter that rejects API calls containing prohibited words
test_violation: test a string against a banned keywords list and raise an HTTPException on match
run_async_pre_call_hook: run a pre-call hook that scans incoming messages for banned keywords before API calls
review_async_post_call_success_hook: review the post-call success hook that checks response content for banned keywords
run_async_post_call_streaming_hook: run a streaming hook that checks streaming responses for banned keywords
